description: Open the spreadsheet at /home/ga/Documents/Spreadsheets/credit_disputes_template.xlsx. The 'Discovered Errors' sheet contains messy notes about credit report errors. Create a structured tracking system in the 'Dispute Tracker' sheet with columns for Bureau Name, Error Description, Account Number, Date Error Discovered, Date Dispute Sent, Certified Mail Tracking Number, 30-Day Response Deadline (calculated with formula), Status, Documentation Attached, and Notes. Transform the 4 errors from the notes into organized rows. Add formulas to calculate 30-day deadlines by adding 30 to the sent date. Include realistic USPS tracking numbers (format: 9999 9999 9999 9999 9999 99). Add status indicators. Save the spreadsheet (Ctrl+S).
